parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response.

Valid values: zh (Chinese) and en (English).

parameters.name: Category
parameters.description:
The category of the plugin. Valid values:

- 0: user-defined

- 1: authentication and authorization

- 2: security protection

- 3: transport protocol

- 4: traffic control

- 5: traffic monitoring

parameters.name: EnableOnly
parameters.description: If true, returns only enabled plugins.

parameters.name: GatewayUniqueId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the gateway.
